==Ingredients==

* 6 large [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], washed
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] and [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]] to taste
* 6 slices [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], cooked and [[cookbook:Crumble|crumbled]]; or 4 tablespoons bacon bits
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Boil|hard boiled]] [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* ⅓ cup [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Parsley|fresh parsley]]
* ¼  teaspoon salt
* ¼  teaspoon pepper
* [[Cookbook:Paprika|Paprika]]

==Procedure==

# Cut tops from tomatoes.
# Scoop out pulp, leaving shells intact.
# Chop tomato pulp.
# Drain tomato shells and sprinkle cavities with salt and pepper.
# Combine tomato pulp, bacon, celery, eggs, mayonnaise, parsley, and measured salt and pepper.
# Stir well.
# Fill tomato shell with bacon and egg mixture.
# Sprinkle with paprika.
